### CVE-2003-0127
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2003-03-18 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 3: Linux Kernel 2.2.x/2.4.x (RedHat) - 'ptrace/kmod' Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2003-03-30, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 22362: Linux Kernel 2.2.x/2.4.x - Privileged Process Hijacking Privilege Escalation (1) (local/linux, 2003-03-17, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 22363: Linux Kernel 2.2.x/2.4.x - Privileged Process Hijacking Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2003-04-10, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 12: Linux Kernel < 2.4.20 - Module Loader Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2003-04-14, verified=1)

The kernel module loader in Linux kernel 2.2.x before 2.2.25, and 2.4.x before 2.4.21, allows local users to gain root privileges by using ptrace to attach to a child process that is spawned by the kernel.

### CVE-2003-0619
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2003-08-01 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 68: Linux Kernel 2.4.20 - 'decode_fh' Denial of Service (dos/linux, 2003-07-29, verified=1)

Integer signedness error in the decode_fh function of nfs3xdr.c in Linux kernel before 2.4.21 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (kernel panic) via a negative size value within XDR data of an NFSv3 procedure call.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2003-12-02 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 129: Linux Kernel 2.4.22 - 'do_brk()' Local Privilege Escalation (1) (local/linux, 2003-12-02, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 131: Linux Kernel 2.4.22 - 'do_brk()' Local Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2003-12-05, verified=1)

### CVE-2003-0985
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-09-01 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 145: Linux Kernel 2.4.23/2.6.0 - 'do_mremap()' Bound Checking Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2004-01-15, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 141: Linux Kernel 2.4.23/2.6.0 - 'do_mremap()' Bound Checking Validator (1) (local/linux, 2004-01-06, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 142: Linux Kernel 2.4.23/2.6.0 - 'do_mremap()' Bound Checking Validator (2) (local/linux, 2004-01-07, verified=1)

The mremap system call (do_mremap) in Linux kernel 2.4.x before 2.4.21, and possibly other versions before 2.4.24, does not properly perform bounds checks, which allows local users to cause a denial of service and possibly gain privileges by causing a remapping of a virtual memory area (VMA) to create a zero length VMA, a different vulnerability than CAN-2004-0077.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
